change.summary: Extend the isolated Next HTTP harness and PostgreSQL integration packet with independent next start builds, Last-Event-ID replay and prompt cross-process session-revocation closure; refresh the control-plane evidence and realtime documentation.

critic.largest_gap: No independent report arrived; target TLS/proxy/IdP, representative load, restart/failover, real storage/AV/sink, production recovery, relational cutover and clinical/hospital acceptance remain unproven.
critic.mechanism: Fresh non-inherited read-only subagent was given the current source, packet and frozen criteria; two bounded wait windows totaling 90 seconds produced no report, after which the agent was closed.

estimated_cost: One focused HTTP run, one complete disposable PostgreSQL regression run, bounded type/lint/docs/security/performance/recovery checks, evidence reconciliation and one fresh read-only critic with two bounded wait windows.

evidence.environment: Disposable PostgreSQL 16.15 on loopback; Node 22; Next.js 16.3.0; one next dev scenario and two independent next start processes from isolated production builds; synthetic fixture; local S3-compatible health responder and external-scanner configuration shape only; pre-existing 127.0.0.1:5432 untouched.
evidence.outcome: Dedicated HTTP file passed 2/2 in 26.68s. It proved shared-session authentication, PostgreSQL LISTEN/NOTIFY wake-up without clinical notification payload, durable authorized delivery, next-start Last-Event-ID replay of only the later event, and prompt B-stream closure after A revokes the shared session.

evidence.environment: Fresh disposable PostgreSQL 16.15 cluster on loopback; complete Vitest PostgreSQL integration configuration; cluster stopped after execution; pre-existing 127.0.0.1:5432 listener untouched.
evidence.outcome: Complete PostgreSQL suite passed 5 files and 24/24 tests in 35.62s; all child Next processes, disposable database processes and temporary HTTP resources were cleaned up.

expected_value: Bind the public HTTP realtime boundary to a current fingerprint and close the locally actionable next-start replay and revocation gaps while keeping target-production and human-acceptance limits explicit.
gap: The prior packet proved process-level fanout in next dev but did not exercise the public next start boundary, reconnect replay or cross-process session revocation.
hypothesis: Two independent next dev/next start processes sharing one disposable PostgreSQL can preserve session authorization, deliver durable scope-filtered SSE events through LISTEN/NOTIFY, replay only later events after Last-Event-ID and close an active stream after shared-session revocation without clinical data in the notification payload.
next_gap: Obtain an independent review report and authorized target-equivalent evidence for proxy/TLS/IdP, representative realtime/outbox load, restart/failover, real storage/AV/recovery, relational authority/cutover, clinical policy and hospital acceptance.
retest: typecheck, lint, validate:docs, engineering-framework state checker, control-plane JSON/JSONL parse, git diff --check, security scan, npm audit --audit-level=high, test:perf 7/7, test:recovery 5/5 and the final focused/full PostgreSQL HTTP runs are green; the broader consolidated validation remains 559/559, build 12 pages, E2E 51/51 and accessibility 6/6.
workstream: HTTP multi-instance PostgreSQL session, realtime fanout, reconnect replay and revocation
